llm.summary: The skill's description matches an A/B analysis tool, but the runtime instructions assume an executable or implementation that isn't included—this mismatch is suspicious and you should verify the actual implementation before trusting or using it with real data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim an A/B test analyzer which is reasonable for the instructions provided. However, the skill is instruction-only with no code or install spec; SKILL.md shows CLI usage (openclaw run ab-test-analyzer ...) that implies a runnable implementation which is not present. The registry version (1.0.32) also differs from skill.json (1.0.0). This is an incoherence between claimed capability and what the package actually provides.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to import CSV data, run analysis, and produce reports. It does not ask the agent to read unrelated system files, access credentials, or exfiltrate data to external endpoints. The only potential issue is the implicit instruction to run a CLI that doesn't exist in the package.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code are provided, which minimizes direct install risk (nothing is written to disk by this package). That said, the absence of an install or binary is the root of the coherence concern: the documentation expects a runnable component that isn't included.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths, which is proportionate to a pure-analysis tool. There are no undeclared environment accesses in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show normal defaults (not always: true). The skill does not request persistent presence or modify system/other-skill configs. No elevated privileges are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears to be documentation-only: SKILL.md describes CLI usage for 'ab-test-analyzer' but no code or installer is included. Before using or trusting it: 1) Ask the publisher for the actual implementation or an install spec (binary, package, or source). 2) Verify the source/homepage and check that the executable the docs reference actually exists and is from a trusted origin. 3) Do not provide sensitive datasets until you confirm where your data will be processed (local vs remote) and that the implementation is trustworthy. 4) The version mismatch (registry 1.0.32 vs skill.json 1.0.0) is another minor red flag—seek clarification. If the author supplies a clear install source (e.g., GitHub release or package registry) and code matches the documentation, the coherence and risk profile will improve.
